아가 2:1.content: I am the rose of Sharon, and the lily of the valleys.

아가 2:2.content: As the lily among thorns, so is my love among the daughters.

아가 2:3.content: As the apple tree among the trees of the wood, so is my beloved among the sons. I sat down under his shadow with great delight, and his fruit was sweet to my taste.

아가 2:4.content: He brought me to the banqueting house, and his banner over me was love.

아가 2:5.content: Stay me with flagons, comfort me with apples: for I am sick of love.

아가 2:6.content: His left hand is under my head, and his right hand doth embrace me.

아가 2:7.content: I charge you, O ye daughters of Jerusalem, by the roes, and by the hinds of the field, that ye stir not up, nor awake my love, till he please.

아가 2:8.content: The voice of my beloved! behold, he cometh leaping upon the mountains, skipping upon the hills.

아가 2:9.content: My beloved is like a roe or a young hart: behold, he standeth behind our wall, he looketh forth at the windows, shewing himself through the lattice.

아가 2:10.content: My beloved spake, and said unto me, Rise up, my love, my fair one, and come away.

아가 2:11.content: For, lo, the winter is past, the rain is over and gone;

아가 2:12.content: The flowers appear on the earth; the time of the singing of birds is come, and the voice of the turtle is heard in our land;

아가 2:13.content: The fig tree putteth forth her green figs, and the vines with the tender grape give a good smell. Arise, my love, my fair one, and come away.

아가 2:14.content: O my dove, that art in the clefts of the rock, in the secret places of the stairs, let me see thy countenance, let me hear thy voice; for sweet is thy voice, and thy countenance is comely.

아가 2:15.content: Take us the foxes, the little foxes, that spoil the vines: for our vines have tender grapes.

아가 2:16.content: My beloved is mine, and I am his: he feedeth among the lilies.

아가 2:17.content: Until the day break, and the shadows flee away, turn, my beloved, and be thou like a roe or a young hart upon the mountains of Bether.
